subject.title: fix(agents): treat unterminated Responses SSE stream as error, not success

question: Should the canonical fix be this state-machine branch or the smaller direct-throw implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133?
rationale: Both branches address the same valid bug, while the permanent failure boundary and the compatibility contract for nonconforming Responses-compatible endpoints are maintainer-owned choices.

options.title: Land this branch
options.body: Refresh this branch onto current main and prefer its broader real HTTP/SSE and tool-use proof as the canonical implementation.

options.title: Land the smaller branch
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133 if maintainers want the processor to throw immediately at EOF with a smaller test change.

options.title: Preserve lenient compatibility
options.body: Pause both branches and define an explicit compatibility mode if terminal-less custom endpoints must remain supported.

recommendation.title: Land this branch
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch onto current main and prefer its broader real HTTP/SSE and tool-use proof as the canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent OpenAI Responses transport review history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for selecting the canonical failure boundary.
